questions.q: In how many different ways can the letters of the word GARDEN be arranged?
What comes next in the series? 18, 23, 29, 36, 44, …
questions.why: The differences go up by 1 each time (5, 6, 7, 8, 9). Next: 53. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Sunil is the mother of Manoj. Manoj is the sister of Geeta. Geeta is the father of Pooja. How is Sunil related to Pooja?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Grandmother. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What comes next in the series? 14, 20, 29, 41, 56, …
questions.why: The differences go up by 3 each time (6, 9, 12, 15, 18). Next: 74. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 39, 45, 51, 54, 63, 69, 75
questions.why: In the correct series each term adds 6, so 54 should be 57. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a group of 110 people, 57 like Konkani, 41 like Marathi and 22 like neither. How many like only Konkani?
questions.why: Both = 57 + 41 − (110 − 22) = 10; only Konkani = 57 − 10 = 47. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Rahul walks 3 m West, then turns right and walks 6 m, then turns right and walks 3 m. Which direction is Rahul facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the East. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statement: Should the government ban plastic bags? Arguments: I. Yes, it will significantly reduce pollution and protect marine life. II. No, it will cause job losses in plastic manufacturing and inconvenience consumers.
opts: Both I and II are strong
questions.why: Both give a direct, serious consequence of the policy. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: A river flows from east to west. It turns left, and then turns right. In which direction is it flowing now?
questions.why: Flowing west, a left turn takes it south, and a right turn brings it back to west.
